rollback_steps: Set EVALUATION_PLANS_ENABLED=false on the backend and restart it. The evaluation menu returns to the existing assessment view.
Keep new evaluation tables and Flyway migration history. Do not drop submitted goals or rewrite applied migrations.

Prefer the feature switch. For a code rollback on a separate branch, revert only application changes from the dedicated feature commit and retain the applied V8 migration file and its database tables. Do not reset shared main or remove Flyway history. Verify against a backup before deployment.
data_policy: Additive tables; existing evaluations are retained. The tag identifies committed source only, not database contents or unrelated uncommitted edits.
